experiences.name: Sunrise Yoga at Campuhan Ridge Walk
experiences.description: Join an open-air yoga session overlooking the lush Campuhan Ridge, followed by a peaceful walk along the scenic ridge trail. A perfect blend of mindfulness and nature immersion in Ubud's spiritual heartland.

experiences.name: Seminyak Beach Sunset Session
experiences.description: Relax on one of Bali's most beautiful beaches, known for its golden sunsets. Rent a sun lounger, take a dip in the warm Indian Ocean, and enjoy the vibrant beach club atmosphere as the sun dips below the horizon.

experiences.name: Beachfront Yoga Retreat Class in Canggu
experiences.description: Attend a drop-in yoga class at one of Canggu's renowned beachfront studios like Dojo or The Practice. Classes cater to all levels and are set in stunning open-air pavilions just steps from the surf.

experiences.name: Snorkeling at Padang Bai Blue Lagoon
experiences.description: Explore the crystal-clear turquoise waters of Blue Lagoon Beach, one of Bali's best snorkeling spots. Discover vibrant coral reefs, tropical fish, and sea turtles in a sheltered and calm bay perfect for all skill levels.

experiences.name: Traditional Balinese Cooking Class & Temple Visit
experiences.description: Start with a guided visit to a local morning market, then learn to prepare authentic Balinese dishes like satay lilit and black rice pudding. Many classes include a brief visit to a nearby temple for cultural context.
